meta.subject: fixed snoop forwarding bug and single bank support

en.summary: Mixed commit, but the verified DUT fix is the snoop-forwarder queue wraparound and full-detection correction.
why_it_counts: The real behavioral fix is in a cache snoop-forwarding RTL module, not in test or build code.
The patch adds explicit ring-buffer full detection and wrapped entry indexing for outstanding snoop requests.
The single-bank support edits are separable from the snoop-forwarder bug fix.
disqualifiers: The same commit also includes substantial single-bank support changes in other cache files.
evidence: VX_snp_forwarder.v widens rd_ptr and wr_ptr, derives wrapped entry indices rd_a and wr_a, and adds an explicit full condition using the pointer MSB.
snp_req_ready changes from a pending_size threshold to !full && fwdout_ready.
Outgoing forward tags switch from raw wr_ptr to wrapped queue index wr_a, and dequeue uses pending_cntrs[rd_a] instead of pending_cntrs[rd_ptr].

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This fix corrects bookkeeping for a small queue that tracks outstanding snoop broadcasts until all forwarded probes respond. The buggy form used insufficient state to distinguish queue wraparound from true empty or full conditions and reused raw queue pointers as entry identifiers. Under sustained snoop traffic, that can overwrite or mis-associate outstanding snoop records once the queue wraps.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: outstanding snoop or broadcast completion queue
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Multiple snoop requests are accepted back-to-back until the pending queue wraps or becomes nearly full while forwarded responses are still returning.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove wrap-aware queue state so enqueue, dequeue, full detection, and response tagging use only the low pointer bits or a size heuristic.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop ring-buffer wrap bit and restore count-based full heuristic
portability_notes: Map this to any structure that tracks one request and waits for multiple probe acknowledgements before releasing the original transaction.
The key fault is not cache-bank addressing; it is losing the ability to disambiguate queue wraparound from empty or full state.
If the target DUT uses response tags derived from queue slots, make those tags come from the wrong pointer representation as part of the mutation.
concrete_injection_steps: Reduce the enqueue and dequeue pointers to entry-index width only, or ignore their wrap bit when testing full and empty.
Replace explicit full detection with a size threshold or another heuristic that cannot distinguish wrapped full from empty.
Use the raw write pointer, rather than the wrapped entry index, as the identifier returned with forwarded probes.
Index completion counters with the unwrapped pointer representation so a wrapped queue can decrement or retire the wrong entry.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit replaces narrow rd_ptr and wr_ptr plus pending_size gating with wrap-aware pointers, explicit full detection, wrapped entry indices, and wrapped forward tags.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_snp_forwarder, revert rd_ptr and wr_ptr to non-wrap-aware indices, remove rd_a, wr_a, and full, gate snp_req_ready with the old size-based condition, and use raw pointers again for enqueue, dequeue, and snoop forward tags.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Queue full or empty can be detected incorrectly after wraparound, leading to overwritten pending snoops, lost responses, or responses matched to the wrong snoop request.
evidence_for_injection: The fixed code introduces explicit full detection from pointer MSBs instead of relying on pending_size.
The fixed code tags forwarded probes with wr_a, showing that slot identity had to be separated from the full pointer state.
The dequeue path now reads pending_cntrs[rd_a], which ties retirement to wrapped slot indexing rather than the raw pointer register.
notes: Do not mix in the single-bank support edits from VX_cache.v and related files.
The portable bug is queue wrap bookkeeping, not bank-address translation.

zh.summary: 这是一个混合提交，但经过核实的 DUT 修复是 snoop forwarder 队列回绕与满队列检测的修正。
why_it_counts: 真正的行为修复位于缓存 snoop forwarding RTL 模块，而不是测试或构建代码。
补丁为未完成 snoop 请求增加了显式环形队列满检测和回绕后的条目索引。
single-bank support 的改动可以与 snoop forwarder 的 bug 修复分离。
disqualifiers: 同一个提交在其他 cache 文件中还包含了较大的 single-bank support 变更。
evidence: VX_snp_forwarder.v 扩展了 rd_ptr 和 wr_ptr，引入回绕条目索引 rd_a 和 wr_a，并使用指针高位增加了显式 full 条件。
snp_req_ready 从基于 pending_size 的阈值判断改为 !full && fwdout_ready。
向外转发的 tag 从原始 wr_ptr 改为回绕后的队列索引 wr_a，dequeue 也从 pending_cntrs[rd_ptr] 改为 pending_cntrs[rd_a]。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该修复针对一个小型队列的记账逻辑，该队列用于跟踪已经广播出去、但仍在等待所有 probe 返回的 snoop 请求。缺陷版本没有足够的状态来区分队列回绕后的 full 与 empty，并且把原始队列指针直接当作条目标识使用。在持续 snoop 流量下，一旦队列回绕，就可能覆盖或错误匹配尚未完成的 snoop 记录。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 未完成 snoop 或广播完成队列
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 多个 snoop 请求连续进入，待处理队列在转发响应尚未全部返回时发生回绕或接近满。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 去掉感知回绕的队列状态，使 enqueue、dequeue、满队列检测和响应 tag 只依赖低位指针或一个近似的 size 条件。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除环形队列回绕位并恢复基于计数的满队列启发式
portability_notes: 可映射到任何需要跟踪一个请求并等待多个 probe 确认后才能释放原事务的结构。
关键缺陷不是 cache bank 地址转换，而是丢失了区分回绕后 full 与 empty 的能力。
如果目标 DUT 使用队列槽位作为转发响应的 tag，也应让该 tag 来自错误的指针表示。
concrete_injection_steps: 把 enqueue 和 dequeue 指针缩回仅有条目索引宽度，或在判断 full 和 empty 时忽略其回绕位。
用基于 size 的阈值或其他无法区分回绕 full 与 empty 的启发式逻辑替代显式 full 检测。
让转发 probe 返回的标识使用原始写指针，而不是回绕后的条目索引。
让完成计数器按未回绕的指针表示索引，从而在队列回绕后递减或退休错误的条目。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Snoop forwarder 挂起请求队列
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把窄位宽 rd_ptr 和 wr_ptr 以及 pending_size 门控，替换为带回绕感知的指针、显式 full 检测、回绕条目索引以及回绕后的 forward tag。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_snp_forwarder 中，把 rd_ptr 和 wr_ptr 恢复为不带回绕感知的索引，删除 rd_a、wr_a 和 full，把 snp_req_ready 改回旧的 size 条件，并重新使用原始指针进行 enqueue、dequeue 和 snoop forward tag 生成。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 队列在回绕后可能错误判断 full 或 empty，导致挂起 snoop 被覆盖、响应丢失，或把响应匹配到错误的 snoop 请求。
evidence_for_injection: 修复后的代码使用指针高位显式计算 full，而不是依赖 pending_size。
修复后的代码把转发 probe 的 tag 改为 wr_a，说明槽位标识必须与完整指针状态分离。
dequeue 路径改为访问 pending_cntrs[rd_a]，说明退休动作必须绑定到回绕后的槽位索引，而不是原始指针寄存器。
notes: 不要把 VX_cache.v 及相关文件中的 single-bank support 改动一起注入。
可移植的缺陷核心是队列回绕记账，而不是 bank 地址转换。
